name: Modern Shares & Stockbrokers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1939, Modern Shares & Stock Brokers Ltd is in the business of stockbroking.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MSSL is in the business of providing a range of 
services covering Retail Broking, Mutual Fund 
Distribution, Equity Research, and Advisory Services.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.95 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 92.0 to 29.5 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 250 days to 23.6 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.3% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.16% over last 3 years.
